name: pl.demo.ice.rewrite.UpgradeWebFlowConfiguration
displayName: Upgrade Spring Web Flow XML configuration
description: Maps the generic Spring Web Flow 1.x application-context elements and attributes to Web Flow 4.x.

name: pl.demo.ice.rewrite.UpgradeMainFlowWithWebFlowUpgrader
displayName: Upgrade legacy Spring Web Flow definition
description: Runs Spring's WebFlowUpgrader on legacy flow XML before the Web Flow 4 normalization recipe.

name: pl.demo.ice.rewrite.UpgradeWebXmlToServletVersion
displayName: Align Jakarta web.xml with the configured Servlet version
description: Derives the descriptor version and schema from the jakarta.servlet-api version configured in the migration POM.

name: pl.demo.ice.rewrite.MigrateJakartaToConfiguredServletVersion
displayName: Migrate Java EE to Jakarta using the configured Servlet version
description: Combines the official Jakarta migration recipe with descriptor alignment to the jakarta.servlet-api version from the migration POM.

name: pl.demo.ice.rewrite.MigrateHibernateWithOfficialRecipes
description: Bridges legacy Hibernate APIs not covered by the official 6.0-to-7.1 migration chain.

name: pl.demo.ice.rewrite.IcefacesTagsToPrimeFaces
displayName: Migrate ICEfaces tags to PrimeFaces and Jakarta Faces
description: Derives same-name component mappings from ICEfaces and PrimeFaces tag libraries and applies explicit aliases.
